windMultiplierText: The number by which the wind strenght should be multiplied (it goes from 0 to about 1.2 in vanilla)
hullSpeedText: The maximum speed at which the sailboat can go.
minSpeedText: The minimum speed a sailboat will sail at with a fully-extended sail, regardless of the wind speed (put 1 to be as fast as rowing)
riversSupportText: Strength of rivers from ImNuts Rivers mod
